AnalyticsPage.title: Analytics
AnalyticsPage.subtitle: Revenue, pipeline, and team activity at a glance
AnalyticsPage.rangeCustomDescription: Both dates are included. Times are in {timezone}.
AnalyticsPage.overviewSubtitle: Results, relationships, and how the team is working — in one look
AnalyticsPage.trendsSubtitle: How revenue and activity changed across the selected period
AnalyticsPage.diagnosticsSubtitle: What is driving your numbers, and what needs attention next
AnalyticsPage.revenueInfo: What you have won against what your open deals are worth, month by month.
AnalyticsPage.stageInfo: Open deals in this pipeline, by stage. The bar is total value; the number is how many deals.
AnalyticsPage.winRateInfo: Deals you closed this period, won against lost. The middle is your win rate.
AnalyticsPage.activityInfo: Everything logged this period, by type.
AnalyticsPage.teamInfo: Who logged the most: activities, completed tasks, and notes.
AnalyticsPage.agingInfo: Open deals by stage and how long since anything happened. Under 7 days is fresh; over 60 days is stalled.
AnalyticsPage.topDealsInfo: Biggest open deals by expected value; biggest wins by actual value.
AnalyticsPage.pipelineValueInfo: Won revenue this period plus what is still open, for each pipeline. Empty pipelines are left out.
AnalyticsPage.emptyBody: As you add deals and log activity, this page fills in with revenue trends, win rates, pipeline value, and team momentum.
AnalyticsPage.warmthSubtitle: Where your relationships stand right now
AnalyticsPage.warmthInfo: Contacts and companies grouped as hot, warm, cool, or cold — based on how recently and how often you have been in touch. Trend shows who is warming up, holding steady, or cooling off.
AnalyticsPage.decayInfo: Contacts still warm today who will go cold if you don't reach out, grouped by how soon. This is about people, not deals.
AnalyticsPage.dealRiskInfo: Open deals that look at risk, grouped by how serious it is and why. The value is what those deals are worth.
AnalyticsPage.taskStatusSubtitle: Across every open and closed task
AnalyticsPage.taskStatusInfo: Tasks by where they stand: to do, in progress, or done. The middle shows how many are done.
AnalyticsPage.introsInfo: Introductions you could make, and the ones you actually made this period.
AnalyticsPage.movesInfo: Contacts who recently changed jobs. Someone who liked working with you is a good opening at their new company.

AnalyticsKpis.warmShareTooltip: How many of your contacts are hot or warm right now. Contacts with nothing logged yet aren't counted.
AnalyticsKpis.activityTooltip: Calls, emails, meetings, and notes logged this period.
